FT-038.adaptation: Re-verified math-layout's current public Nucleus before designing (rev1 habit kept): Radical is now a struct variant {radicand, degree}, not rev1's tuple variant, and Text/Overline/Underline/Styled were added since rev1 — rev1's code would not compile against this tree. Added NodeId (stable structural identity, Display, rebuild-stability test) covering every emitted node via a new Description.nodes list, not just Unsupported entries. Added an independent total-node-count bound (max_nodes/NodeCountExceeded) alongside the existing depth bound, so a wide-but-shallow tree is caught even at depth 1; both bounds have dedicated tests. Kept rev1's no-guessed-speech rule for unknown symbol/accent characters unchanged, extended to all eleven current Nucleus variants.
